question: Should Crabbox sponsor a first-class SkyPilot Sandbox provider, and which stable integration interface should it target?
rationale: The existing provider contract makes an adapter plausible, but adopting and maintaining another provider requires explicit product ownership, support intent, and an agreed integration boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a design spike
options.body: Require a capability matrix and small live delegated-run prototype before approving full implementation.

options.title: Wait for a stable contract
options.body: Defer engineering until SkyPilot exposes a sufficiently stable and supported integration interface.

options.title: Decline built-in support
options.body: Prefer the existing Kubernetes or external-provider paths if SkyPilot offers insufficient distinct value for another built-in adapter.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a design spike
recommendation.body: Require a capability matrix and small live delegated-run prototype before approving full implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Broad recent provider-framework and registry history makes this the strongest available owner for the product-level support decision.
